title: Drummers and following parades as a boy
summary: He lists good drummers (Black Happy, Black Benny, Snag) and recalls following parades as a boy before he could play.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
